takeaway: Higgsfield's CEO says it hit a $1.35B annualized run rate in October. Jane Street's one-skill repo accelerated to +2,063 stars in a day. DeepSeek Harness's daily users, now read from the source page, went from 271,000 (late September) to 1.54 million (early November).

findings.heading: Higgsfield: $1.35B run rate in October
findings.text: CEO Alex Mashrabov posted: 'We crossed $1B and got faster. In October we hit $1.35B.' The post names only the month, so it is dated to the Nov 11 post.

findings.heading: Jane Street's skill repo accelerates
findings.text: janestreet/agent_skills gained 2,063 stars in a day, to 6,236, up from 1,641 the day before. It holds a single tutoring skill.

findings.heading: DeepSeek Harness daily users, from the page
findings.text: Daily users of DeepSeek's official API: 271,000 (week ended Sept 30), 429,000 (Oct 7), 1.54 million (Nov 4). Read in full via Tavily; earlier only search snippets were available.

findings.heading: An 'uncensored' model's likes jump
findings.text: A safety-removed DeepSeek-V4-Pro merge went from 1,254 to 4,280 likes in a day against 16,693 downloads, a ratio far above normal. Reviewed as unclear.

findings.heading: Nov 5 forecast: 3 of 15 top picks right
findings.text: Its top 100 scored a rank correlation of 0.45, but its top 15 held only 3 of the real top 15, the lowest hit rate so far.

caveats: A cracked-software repo ranked #24 in today's report before it was marked out of scope; the page's app table already leaves it out.
The Higgsfield figure is the CEO's own post, not a company filing.
Hacker News and npm remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
